ValidationRule.description: Requires an Accepted Deal Review to be marked on the Oppty before the stage is advanced past Stage 4. ONLY APPLIES for North America
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName , "5 - Signed/PO in"), ISPICKVAL(StageName , "6 - Setup"), ISPICKVAL(StageName , "7 - Closed") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Deal"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal") ), Region__c = "North America", ISBLANK(Deal_Review_Accepted__c), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName ='Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName ='IMAP_Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName ='IME_Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName ='IMLA_Standard_Opportunity' ), DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) >= DATEVALUE($Label.Opty_Createddate) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An Accepted Deal Review is required to move the Opportunity Stage to 5-Signed/PO In.
